recorded_option_notes.complete_image_packing_comparison: The initial runner recorded fused_packing=true for all operand and gate packing. The final runner expresses this as --fused-packing all.
recorded_option_notes.three_mode_comparison: The full-image candidate uses gate-only fusion; diagnostic post-stage timing separately checks none, gate and all.
recorded_option_notes.whole_network_comparison: The full-image candidate uses all packing; whole-network graph timing checks none and all.

limitations: Plain packing is slower in the contiguous microbenchmark; do not generalize the activation gain.
Whole reconstructed-network timing excludes feature preparation, grading and application integration; it includes the unused original head.
Output equality preserves the imperfect candidate, not native renderer quality.
Native runtime remains approximately 5.4 ms; the reconstructed candidate is still much slower.
